close_reason: __mix_recompile__?/0 emitted per kernel module: raw CC/ERTS_INCLUDE_DIR values baked at compile time, compared each mix compile; repro verified end to end (merged, 0526e33)
description:
> *This was generated by AI during research for docs/research/elixir-compilers-and-idioms.md.*

`CC` and `ERTS_INCLUDE_DIR` are read at compile time (lib/defk/build.ex L45, L252, L290, L346) and feed the build-cache key, but nothing tells Mix to recompile kernel modules when they change. Reproduced 2026-10-12 in a scratch Mix app depending on defk by path: after a clean `mix compile`, `CC=/nonexistent/cc mix compile` exits 0 and rebuilds nothing; only `--force` re-runs the C build (which then fails with defk's own "C compiler not found" error).

Documented hook: `__mix_recompile__?/0` (called for every module, so it must be cheap), e.g. comparing the `CC`/`ERTS_INCLUDE_DIR` values stored at compile time with the current environment. See the note's "Three mechanisms in depth" (external inputs) section and the audit's "Untracked compile-time dependencies" row.
title: Changing CC or ERTS_INCLUDE_DIR does not recompile kernel modules (no __mix_recompile__?/0)
